faction_snapshot.description: An offensive army of legion infantry, riderless drake-hounds, axe-throwing Reckoners, covert spellblades, hemomancers, minotaurs and bound Ruin Bringers. Neutral alignment is a game rule, not absolution of imperial coercion. The covert pact and recruitable Atakhan-inspired demons are explicit project fiction.
faction_snapshot.name: Noxus

blacksmith.description: Sells the native Ammo Cart. It supports finite ranged troop ammunition, not extra attacks.
blacksmith.name: Legion Armory

capitol.description: Produces 4000 gold per day; normal native Capitol ownership restrictions apply.
capitol.name: Imperial Seat

castle.description: Adds native castle growth, towers and stronger walls.
castle.name: Noxian Bastion

citadel.description: Adds native citadel growth, keep and moat.
citadel.name: Redoubt

dwellingLvl3.description: Recruits ranged Axe Reckoners, not copies of Draven.
dwellingLvl3.name: Reckoners' Yard

dwellingLvl4.description: Recruits Rose Spellblades under a local clandestine agreement. Teleport movement is a game adaptation, not universal Black Rose power.
dwellingLvl4.name: Veiled Lodge

dwellingLvl5.description: Recruits living ranged Crimson Disciples. Lesser hemomancers, not Vladimir clones or imperial priests.
dwellingLvl5.name: Crimson Study

dwellingLvl6.description: Recruits Minotaur Reckoners. Individual Noxian service is not an assertion that all minotaurs support the empire.
dwellingLvl6.name: Minotaur Fighting Pit

dwellingLvl7.description: Recruits flying Ruin Bringers: explicitly invented bound demons inspired by the unique Atakhan, not multiple Atakhans. Their flight is bound magic and a declared game adaptation, not a claim that Atakhan flies.
dwellingLvl7.name: Rift of Ruin

dwellingUpLvl1.description: Recruits and upgrades Legion Veterans from the shared tier-one pool.
dwellingUpLvl1.name: Veterans' Barracks

dwellingUpLvl2.description: Recruits Armored Drake-Hounds from the shared tier-two pool.
dwellingUpLvl2.name: Armored Pens

dwellingUpLvl3.description: Recruits Veteran Axe Reckoners from the shared tier-three pool.
dwellingUpLvl3.name: Veterans' Arena

dwellingUpLvl4.description: Recruits Rose Infiltrators from the shared tier-four pool.
dwellingUpLvl4.name: Hidden Chapter

dwellingUpLvl5.description: Recruits Crimson Adepts with one action-cost Basic Curse charge from the shared tier-five pool.
dwellingUpLvl5.name: Crimson Circlehouse

dwellingUpLvl6.description: Recruits Veteran Minotaurs with a dangerous rear-hex cleave from the shared tier-six pool.
dwellingUpLvl6.name: Grand Reckoning Pit

dwellingUpLvl7.description: Recruits Greater Ruin Bringers from the same tier-seven pool. No resurrection, teleporting, shooter or casualty economy.
dwellingUpLvl7.name: Greater Binding Rift

grail.description: A fictional local Grail monument: native Grail mode, +5000 daily gold and 50% growth. It asserts no identity for Guile.
grail.name: Standard of the Three Principles

mageGuild4.description: Teaches native fourth-circle spells. Fifth-circle access is deliberately omitted.
mageGuild4.name: War College IV

marketplace.description: Native resource trade with other markets.
marketplace.name: Campaign Market

resourceSilo.description: Produces one sulfur per day. This local hall and resource yield are project adaptations, not a canonical imperial priesthood.
resourceSilo.name: Crimson Citadel

ship.description: Automatic native vessel display, not a separate construction or income source.
ship.name: Moored Vessel

shipyard.description: Native coastal shipyard only where the adventure-map location permits boats.
shipyard.name: Imperial River Dock

rewards.message: Clandestine observers teach your hero to read the horizon. This training grants at most one additional sight tile.

special1.description: Click with a visiting hero to learn +1 personal sight, strongest-only across this training and Swain's specialty. A clandestine local pact is project fiction, not Black Rose obedience to the state.
special1.name: Black Rose Academy

special2.description: Defenders of this town gain +2 Attack in siege. This fictional local assembly does not make every veteran a Trifarix councillor.
special2.name: Trifarian Hall

special3.description: Produces 150 gold per day. A fictional local Reckoning arena, with spectacle, coercion and political exploitation.
special3.name: Arena of Valor

special4.description: Prerequisite for the Rift of Ruin. This project-fiction clandestine binding does not recruit Atakhan, breed a canonical demon species, consume casualties or provide a second growth pool.
special4.name: Binding Vault

tavern.description: Native hero recruitment; special scenario heroes remain excluded.
tavern.name: Legion Tavern

villageHall.description: Produces 500 gold per day. Replaced, not added to, by higher hall income.
villageHall.name: Legion Outpost
